allowedSourceMaterial.overview: Sy Parrish has lovingly developed photographs for the Yorkin family since their son was a baby. But as the Yorkins' lives become fuller, Sy's only seems lonelier, until he eventually convinces himself he's part of their family. When Sy's picture-perfect fantasy collides with an ugly dose of reality, a bizarre and thrilling confrontation ensues.

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: What happens when an outsider's carefully nurtured delusion crashes into an unforgiving dose of reality?
visibleEditorialCopy.description: Photo lab technician Sy Parrish has developed snapshots for the Yorkin family for years, but his isolated existence gradually twists into an unhealthy belief that he belongs inside their picture-perfect world.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: A steady, suspenseful psychological drama built on isolation and quiet tension, rewarding engaged solitary viewing.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Mark Romanek steers this taut 96-minute thriller with quiet precision, letting an intimate drama of loneliness build into an unsettling study of suburban obsession.
